# Khitma.net (ختمة.نت)

> A free web app for reading the whole Quran together. Someone creates a group khitma and shares its link, usually in a WhatsApp group. Each participant opens the link, writes their name, picks one of the 30 juz (ajza) to read, and marks it done when finished; everyone sees the progress until the khitma is complete. No account and nothing to install. Arabic by default, also in English, French, Spanish and German.

Khitma.net has been used for tens of thousands of group khitmas since 2021, mostly by families and friends in the Arab world and in Muslim communities abroad.

## What people use it for

- A khitma for someone who passed away (ختمة عن روح ...): the family shares the link and completes the Quran together, often within a week.
- A recurring khitma for a group (daily, weekly or monthly): the admin starts the next round with one button, and each member can automatically get the next juz.
- A khitma during Ramadan, for healing (شفاء), or for a shared intention (نيّة).

## How it works

1. Create a khitma at https://khitma.net/new: one-time or recurring, with a title and the organiser's name.
2. Share the invite link. Participants join with their name only.
3. Each participant books a juz, reads it, and taps "أتممت قراءة جزء" (I finished reading juz …).
4. The organiser can share a WhatsApp-ready status message, mark juz done on behalf of others, edit who has each juz, and start a new khitma.

Other group types: "same task" (everyone reads the same portion, e.g. one juz a day) and "page distribution" (the 604 pages are split evenly between members).

## Guides (Arabic)

- [A khitma for someone who passed away](https://khitma.net/guide/khitma-for-the-deceased/): organising it with family over WhatsApp, step by step, and the supplication for the deceased.
- [The group Ramadan khitma](https://khitma.net/guide/ramadan-group-khitma/): one khitma during the month, or a complete khitma every day with 30 people.
- [Organising a group khitma over WhatsApp](https://khitma.net/guide/whatsapp-group-khitma/): one link instead of copied name lists.
